Class EventDTO

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.dto.EventDTO
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class EventDTO extends Object implements Serializable
Bundles the outcome of a card-event phase for transmission to all clients.

Built by GameState.applyEvents(GamePhaseEnum) at the end of each event phase (upper or lower card list depending on the current GamePhaseEnum). It carries two parallel pieces of information:

  • events — the CardDTOs of every card whose effect fired during the phase, in application order.
  • stats — a post-application snapshot of every player's statistics, so the client can update its display in one round-trip.

Sent to clients via EventMessage. If isEmpty() returns true the phase produced no visible effects and the message may be suppressed.
